title: Salts of Carrion Crawler Tentacle
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Crawler Mucus.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Vitriol to make Crawler Mucus.
fields.Result: Coats hits with paralysis and Poisoned on a failed DC 13 Constitution save.
fields.Base value: 45 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
